title: Weak inhomogeneous Duffin-Schaeffer
exact_target: Fix a real shift gamma and a finite-valued nonnegative function psi on positive integers. If $sum_q$ phi(q)psi(q)/q diverges, must almost every real x satisfy $||qx-\gamma ||<\psi (q)$ for infinitely many q, with no coprimality restriction on the approximating numerator?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
